analytics.topProducts.empty: Product-level data will appear after shoppers interact with your widget on product pages.

analytics.campaigns.subtitle: Per-campaign impressions, add-to-cart events, and completed sales.

offers.title: Offers
offers.selectTypeSubtitle: Choose how volume pricing appears on product pages.
offers.emptyBody: Your discount campaigns will appear here once created. Choose from our templates to launch your first revenue-boosting offer in under 2 minutes.
offers.emptyFilter: No offers match your filters. Try another tab or search.
offers.toast.duplicated: Offer duplicated as draft — open it to publish discounts
offers.toast.synced: All active discounts synced to Shopify
offers.toast.exported: CSV downloaded — edit in a spreadsheet if needed, then Import
offers.toast.importPremium: Import & export is available on Premium. Upgrade to unlock.
offers.toast.activeCap: You’ve reached your plan’s active campaign limit. Upgrade to activate more.
offers.delete.title: Delete this offer?
offers.delete.body: This removes the offer from the app and deletes its automatic discounts in Shopify. This cannot be undone.
offers.delete.bodyPlural: This removes the selected offers from the app and deletes their automatic discounts in Shopify. This cannot be undone.
offers.import.title: Import offers (CSV)
offers.import.body: Download the template, edit in a spreadsheet (Excel etc.), save as CSV, then upload. All allowed values are in the template’s OPTIONS row.
offers.import.replaceHint: {size} KB — drop another file or click to replace
offers.import.overwriteHelp: Update matching names instead of skipping them.
offers.preview.sampleFootnote: Sample preview (€98 unit base). Live theme may differ.
home.subtitle: Volume pricing for your storefront.
home.setupGuideDescription: Five steps to go live with quantity breaks and checkout discounts.
home.adminLanguageHelp: Language for this app inside Shopify Admin. Does not change storefront widget translations (managed in Settings).
home.bannerEmbedOffBody: Turn on Offrefy (global) under Theme settings → App embeds → Save, or click Enable app embed.
home.bannerCompleteSetupBody: Finish the steps below to show quantity breaks on product pages and apply discounts at checkout.
home.bannerEmbedOnBody: Offrefy (global) is on. Hard-refresh a product page (Ctrl+Shift+R) to see quantity breaks.
home.bannerEmbedFailTitle: Could not enable app embed automatically
home.bannerEmbedFailBody: Use Theme editor → App embeds → turn on Offrefy (global) → Save.
home.stepEnableEmbedDesc: Theme settings → App embeds → turn on Offrefy (global) to enable the app. Then add the Quantity breaks block where you want the widget (scripts/CSS load only there).
home.stepEnableEmbedAlt: Illustration of enabling a storefront integration
home.stepAddBlockDesc: Product template → Add block → Quantity breaks (or Add section → Apps). The widget only shows where you place this block.
home.stepAddBlockAlt: Illustration of a product page layout
home.stepCreateOfferDesc: Set tiers, products, and widget styling. Active offers sync as automatic discounts.
home.stepCreateOfferAlt: Illustration of creating a discount offer
home.stepActivateDesc: Only Active offers show on the storefront. Discount rules sync on save. Active: {active}{limit} (total offers: {total})
home.stepSyncDesc: Last sync: {synced}. Use Sync now if the live widget looks outdated.
home.syncHelp: Push active offers and widget config to Shopify. Use after offer or theme changes.
setup.checkComplete: Check icon to indicate completion of Setup Guide
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage sync settings and admin language.
settings.storefrontHelp: Edit widget and cart copy on each offer under the Translations tab (Auto translate and Reset are there too). Shop languages still sync automatically for starter defaults.
settings.languageHelp: Pick a shop language, edit strings below, then Save. This does not change the app admin language.
settings.languageHelpLocked: Upgrade to Standard or Premium to edit translations.
settings.autoTranslateHelp: Select a language, then use Auto translate to fill all fields from the storefront primary language (Discount rules + Display copy). Use Reset to restore the selected language to starter copy.
settings.manualActionsHelp: Instantly push all active offers to your storefront.
settings.ph.heading: e.g. Buy more save more
settings.ph.footnote: e.g. Pick a tier to set quantity, then add to cart.
settings.help.cartDiscount: Shown in cart/checkout, e.g. 6% OFF. Use {{ discount }} and {{ amount }}.
settings.toast.sheetsCreated: Translation sheets created for all Shopify store languages
settings.toast.upgradeTranslations: Storefront translations are available on Standard and Premium. Upgrade to unlock.
settings.toast.englishSource: Storefront primary language is the source language
settings.toast.languageReset: Selected language reset to starter copy
settings.localeScopeHint: Then refresh this page after approving permissions.
settings.refreshLanguagesHint: Use the refresh button if languages were added in Shopify recently.
settings.adminLanguageHelp: Language for this app inside Shopify Admin. Does not change storefront widget translations below.
settings.syncStackingHelp: Offers update Shopify automatically on save. Optional auto intervals also refresh discounts on a schedule.
settings.syncStackingHelpLocked: Offers update Shopify automatically on save. Optional auto intervals also refresh discounts on a schedule.
pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Choose the plan that fits your store.
pricing.plansIntro: Free for 5 campaigns · Standard for 25 · Premium unlimited. Save {percent}% yearly. Current plan: {plan}.
pricing.whatsIncludedSubtitle: Compare features across Free, Standard, and Premium.
pricing.checkoutBody: Automatic discounts at cart and checkout · No codes needed · Powered by Shopify Discount Functions
pricing.plan.free.description: Quantity breaks, volume discount, and templates.
pricing.plan.premium.description: Unlimited campaigns, import/export, and priority support.
pricing.toast.switchedDemote: Kept {kept} active (plan max {max}); moved {drafted} to draft.
offerEditor.translations.title: Campaign translations
offerEditor.translations.help: Override storefront copy for this offer only. Leave a field empty to use the app starter defaults for that language.
offerEditor.translations.languageHelp: Pick a shop language, edit overrides below, then Save.
offerEditor.translations.resetHelp: Reset clears overrides for the selected language so this offer uses starter defaults again.
offerEditor.translations.cartBadgeHelp: Cart & checkout badge for this offer. Supports {{ discount }} and {{ amount }}.
offerEditor.translations.tierCopyHelp: Translate option labels, subtext, and badges for each quantity tier. Leave empty to use the Discount rules text from the storefront primary language (Buy prefix still follows “Tier label prefix”).
offerEditor.tier.optionLabelHelp: Overrides the automatic “Buy 1”, “Buy 10–14” text from quantities. Leave empty to use the default range labels.
offerEditor.tier.optionSubtextHelp: Shown under the option name (color and size: Appearance). Use for extra copy on any tier.
offerEditor.tier.badgeHelp: Leave empty to hide the pill. New offers pre-fill “Most Popular ⚡” on the first tier only; other tiers stay blank unless you add a badge.
offerEditor.campaignNameHelp: Internal name for this offer in the app. Customer-facing text is set under Display settings.
offerEditor.discountedProductsHelp: Choose what this discount applies to. Use Browse to pick resources from your store.
offerEditor.quantityConditionsHelp: Choose how Buy quantity tiers are counted — cart total, per product, per variant, or per collection.
offerEditor.schedule.startHelp: Offer goes Active at this time.
offerEditor.schedule.endHelp: Offer turns Draft at this time.
offerEditor.targetCustomerHelp: Choose which customers can use this discount.
offerEditor.widgetTextHelp: Product page copy. Fonts and colors: Appearance tab.
offerEditor.buttonAction.help: Main CTA and tier + Add. Page URL must be on this shop.
offerEditor.buttonAction.helpVolume: Main button below the pricing table. Page URL must be on this shop.
offerEditor.pageUrlHelp: e.g. /pages/shipping or a full URL on this shop.
offerEditor.advanced.intro: Theme form visibility, widget chrome, and tier card price display.
offerEditor.advanced.introVolume: Theme product form visibility. Tier options apply only to Quantity breaks.
offerEditor.advanced.themeIntro: Hide theme form controls on the product page.
offerEditor.advanced.widgetIntro: Widget chrome and tier card price display.
offerEditor.advanced.hideThemeAddToCartH: Theme form only. Use the widget button to add.
offerEditor.advanced.hideThemeBuyItNowHe: Hides Shop Pay / dynamic checkout on the form.
offerEditor.advanced.hideThemeVariantPic: Pick variant in the widget (keep widget variant on).
offerEditor.advanced.hideThemeQuantityHe: Removes qty on the product form only.
offerEditor.advanced.hideThemePriceHelp: Hides the theme product price; tier cards still show prices.
offerEditor.advanced.hideWidgetMainCta: Hide widget Add to cart button
offerEditor.advanced.hideWidgetMainCtaHe: Removes only this offer's main button under the table. Use Hide theme Add to cart above for the theme's button.
offerEditor.advanced.hideWidgetVariantDr: Use the theme's variant UI instead.
offerEditor.advanced.hideOutOfStockVaria: Unavailable variants are omitted from the widget dropdown only.
offerEditor.advanced.hideWidgetQuantityH: Tier minimum only; no +/- in the widget.
offerEditor.advanced.hideWidgetLineTotal: Hides qty × price in the expanded row.
offerEditor.advanced.showPerItemPrice: Show per-item price in tier cards
offerEditor.advanced.showPerItemPriceHel: Off: tier total. On: each price. "You save" is unchanged.
offerEditor.advanced.hideCompareAtPrice: Hide compare-at price in tier cards
offerEditor.advanced.hideCompareAtPriceH: Removes strikethrough; sale price and savings can still show.
offerEditor.widget.titleAlignmentNote: Title alignment is in Appearance → Title & countdown.
offerEditor.widget.timerScheduleNotice: Timer shows only when a schedule is set.
offerEditor.widget.titleCountdownHelp: Arranges the title and countdown in the header. Layout = structure, alignment = position.
offerEditor.widget.titleCountdownSubHelp: Layout, order, and horizontal alignment of the title and countdown.
offerEditor.widget.layoutHelp: Wide screens: share the row or stack vertically.
offerEditor.widget.layoutOptionVolume.sp: One row: title and countdown side by side
offerEditor.widget.layoutOptionVolume.st: Two rows: title on top, countdown below
offerEditor.themeSetup.help: Add the {type} app block on the product template (Online Store → Themes → Customize). Empty heading hides the title.
offerEditor.themeSetup.badgeNote: Badge (Rule settings): tier field shows a pill; clear to hide. New offers default to “Most Popular ⚡” on tier 1.
offerEditor.themeSetup.volumeNote: Volume discount uses a pricing table (quantity, discount, price per item). Tier labels come from Rule settings.
offerEditor.themeSetup.appEmbedNote: Widget in editor but not live? Enable Offrefy (global) under Theme settings → App embeds, then save.
offerEditor.expiredHint: To turn on, set a future end time in
offerEditor.appearance.intro: Styles for the product-page widget. Copy: Display settings · Timer: Countdown timer.
offerEditor.appearance.introVolume: Styles for the product-page pricing table. Copy: Display settings · Timer: Countdown timer.
offerEditor.appearance.templatesHelp: Colors, radii, badge shape & placement. Tweaks → Custom.
offerEditor.appearance.templatePreviewLo: Preview only — upgrade to unlock and save
offerEditor.appearance.templateSaveBlock: This appearance template is available on Premium. Upgrade to unlock before saving.
Standard unlocks 3 templates per season. Premium unlocks all. Upgrade to save this template.
offerEditor.font.typeHelp: Fonts follow your theme typography. Change families in Theme settings or Custom CSS.
offerEditor.font.sizePxHelpVolume: {min}–{max} px. Only roles used by the volume table are listed. Countdown sizes appear when Show countdown is on.
offerEditor.font.role.title: Title
offerEditor.font.weightsHelp: CSS numeric weights (100–900). Strong = title, tier label, price, CTA; accent = badge, countdown pill, qty buttons; body = subtext; normal = footnote, muted lines.
offerEditor.font.weightsHelpVolume: CSS numeric weights (100–900). Strong: title, header, price, button. Accent: countdown pill. Normal: footnote and muted text.
offerEditor.layout.heading: Layout
offerEditor.layout.tableCornerRadiusHelp: Corners of the pricing table container.
offerEditor.layout.tableRowHeightHelp: Vertical padding inside each table cell.
offerEditor.layout.tableColumnsHelp: Text alignment and left/right padding inside each column.
offerEditor.layout.mainButtonRadiusHelp: Primary button under the table (e.g. Add to cart).
offerEditor.layout.tierCardRadiusHelp: Corner radius for each tier row.
offerEditor.layout.qtyAddRadiusHelp: Variant menu, quantity stepper, and “+ Add” button.
offerEditor.layout.tierRadioSizeHelp: Diameter of the circle next to each tier option.
offerEditor.badge.positionHelp: Badge text: Rule settings → Discount rules.
offerEditor.badge.sizeHelp: Scales tier badge text and padding.
offerEditor.badge.designHelp: Shape only — colors stay in Appearance.
offerEditor.colors.title: Colors
offerEditor.colors.help: Hex or rgba; swatch opens the picker.
offerEditor.customCss.title: Custom CSS
offerEditor.customCss.helpTierCard: Extra rules injected on the storefront root (.xloxi-qb). Admin preview: .vd-admin-qb-preview (tier card preview). Field: customCss.
offerEditor.customCss.helpVolumeTable: Extra rules injected on the storefront root (.xloxi-qb). Admin preview: .vd-admin-qb-preview (volume table preview). Field: customCss.
offerEditor.ctaAction.add_to_cart_open_d: Add to cart + open side cart
